ledger: Collage Studio — Wall of Wishes. APPEND-ONLY public credit ledger: every capability built from a wish credits the person who wished it, permanently. The immutability IS git history — this file is committed to a public repo, hash-chained, forked, and archived, so a credit can never be quietly erased. NEVER rewrite or remove an entry; only append. Anonymous wishers are credited as 'an anonymous Collage user'. Isomorphed from av/credits.json, which proved the pattern first.

credits.where: Settings panel — Arrangement and Crop focus, and both are rolled by the dice
credits.wish: More unique algorithms and sorting capabilities like the color match. Also maybe twisting capabilities or cropping algorithms for what to center on. Anything arrangement and composition wise to create more variation in the dice
credits.shipped_note: Shipped: 11 arrangements (photo metric x fragment spatial key, zipped — not a list sort) and 5 crop-focus modes, both rolled by the dice and carried in the share code. NOT yet shipped from this wish: 'twisting' (per-fragment rotation), which needs the draw loop in stage.ts plus both export paths and is its own increment.

credits.where: Settings panel — Twist, and it is rolled by the dice
credits.wish: More unique algorithms and sorting capabilities like the color match. Also maybe twisting capabilities or cropping algorithms for what to center on. Anything arrangement and composition wise to create more variation in the dice
credits.shipped_note: The 'twisting' half of the same wish, finished. 5 modes (Straight, Tilt, Scatter, Pinwheel, Cascade), rolled by the dice and carried in the share code. The fragments TILE the canvas, so nothing rotates a cell — the clip path stays exactly where it was and the SAMPLING inside it leans, with the destination grown by |cos|+|sin| so the corners cannot open up. Reaches all four render paths (live Stage, static preview, raster export, SVG export) through the one geometry function they already share.

credits.capability: A video just loads and loops — nothing asks about frames
credits.where: Anywhere you add a video, and Settings > the line where the frame switch used to be
credits.wish: You're still asking for how many frames to pull instead of just loading the video. Stop asking for frames period.
credits.shipped_note: The third filing of this complaint, and the first one that changed the surfaces the wisher was actually looking at. The frame-picker route is DELETED, not defaulted off: no sheet, no queue, no genart.framePicker preference (a stale '1' had been pinning returning users to it), no Settings switch, and the button that takes a video no longer calls itself 'Extract frames from a video'. The intake also stopped making you wait for the frame it was pulling: probe + re-open + prime + three seeks became one openClip() pass with one seek, 3,517ms -> 490ms to the clip reaching the collage.
